techStack: Database: better-sqlite3 v12.11.1 — synchronous API; db.pragma() for configuration, db.prepare(sql).run(params) returns {changes, lastInsertRowid}
FK pragma pattern: db.pragma('foreign_keys = ON') — same synchronous call style as the existing db.pragma('journal_mode = WAL')
INSERT OR IGNORE: standard SQLite syntax; result.changes === 1 if row inserted, 0 if duplicate ignored
Test framework: vitest v4.1.5 with supertest; run via 'pnpm test' (vitest run)
TypeScript ~6.0.2 with noUnusedLocals + noUnusedParameters — any added imports must be used
Package manager: pnpm; tests run from src/benchmark-backend directory
features: favouritesService.ts addFavourite: currently does SELECT-then-INSERT (two statements, not atomic); no product existence check; never throws ProductNotFoundError
favouritesService.ts removeFavourite: bug on line with 'result.changes > -1' — always returns true; should be result.changes > 0
favouritesService.ts addFavourite return shape: { favourite: Favourite; created: boolean } — type is correct, no type changes needed
errors/index.ts: ProductNotFoundError(productId) exists — statusCode 404, code PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND, message "Product with id '${productId}' not found"
db/client.ts: sets journal_mode = WAL pragma but does NOT set foreign_keys = ON — FK constraints in schema are currently unenforced

favouriteController.ts (read-only): add handler calls next(err) on throw, so ProductNotFoundError thrown from service correctly produces 404 response; remove handler checks boolean return to send 404 vs 204
architecture: Only two files are allowed to change: src/db/client.ts and src/services/favouritesService.ts
Read-only files (per req 8): src/controllers/favouriteController.ts, src/routes/favouriteRoutes.ts, src/db/migrations/*.sql
Error flow: service throws AppError subclass → controller catches and calls next(err) → errorHandler middleware maps err.statusCode → JSON response
DB client is a singleton exported as { db } from '../db/client'; services import and use it directly with synchronous prepared statements
Schema (002_favourites.sql): favourites table has UNIQUE(product_id) and REFERENCES products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE — both constraints exist but FK is inactive without the pragma
Products table exists and is referenced; product existence check must query 'SELECT 1 FROM products WHERE id = ?' before insert
edgeCases: Non-existent productId: explicit SELECT on products table must precede INSERT; throw ProductNotFoundError before touching favourites table so FK constraint acts as secondary guard only
Duplicate add (valid productId already favourited): INSERT OR IGNORE is a no-op; result.changes === 0 → created: false → controller returns 200 (not 201)
New add (valid productId not yet favourited): INSERT OR IGNORE inserts row; result.changes === 1 → created: true → controller returns 201
After INSERT OR IGNORE, always do a SELECT to retrieve the row for the return value — needed in both insert and duplicate cases
removeFavourite for non-existent productId: result.changes === 0 → return false → controller sends 404 with { error: 'Favourite not found' }
removeFavourite for existing favourite: result.changes === 1 → return true → controller sends 204 (regression must still pass)
TypeScript strict flags: ProductNotFoundError import must be added to favouritesService.ts since noUnusedLocals is enforced and it will be used

tasks.requirement: Requirement 1: src/benchmark-backend/src/db/client.ts executes db.pragma('foreign_keys = ON') immediately after opening the database connection
tasks.description: Add db.pragma('foreign_keys = ON') to client.ts immediately after the existing db.pragma('journal_mode = WAL') call, so SQLite enforces FK constraints on every connection (both test :memory: and production file-based)

tasks.requirement: Requirement 2 and 3: addFavourite throws ProductNotFoundError when the given productId is absent from the products table (checked before any insert attempt), so POST /api/favourites returns HTTP 404
tasks.description: In favouritesService.ts addFavourite, add an explicit product existence check using db.prepare('SELECT 1 FROM products WHERE id = ?').get(productId) before the insert logic. If the result is undefined, throw new ProductNotFoundError(productId). Also add the ProductNotFoundError import from '../errors/index'.

tasks.requirement: Requirement 4 and 5: addFavourite uses a single atomic INSERT OR IGNORE statement instead of a separate SELECT followed by INSERT, so UNIQUE(product_id) handles deduplication at the DB level; second POST with same productId returns 200 (not 201)
tasks.description: In favouritesService.ts addFavourite, replace the SELECT-then-INSERT two-statement pattern with a single 'INSERT OR IGNORE INTO favourites (id, product_id) VALUES (?, ?)'. Use result.changes === 1 to determine created: true (new insert) vs created: false (duplicate ignored). After the INSERT OR IGNORE, do one SELECT to fetch the row for the return value in both cases.

tasks.requirement: Requirement 6 and 7: removeFavourite evaluates result.changes > 0 (not > -1) to determine whether a row was deleted, returning false when changes === 0, so DELETE /api/favourites/:productId returns HTTP 404 for a non-existent favourite
tasks.description: In favouritesService.ts removeFavourite, change the condition 'result.changes > -1' to 'result.changes > 0'. This is the only change needed — result.changes from better-sqlite3 is always >= 0 so > -1 was always true.
